events.text: Myles Lynn Deering was born.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Myles Lynn Deering ( born 1953 )

events.text: General Deering was appointed adjutant general of Oklahoma by Governor Brad Henry.
events.subject: self
events.quote: General Deering was appointed by Governor of Oklahoma Brad Henry in 2009

events.text: Governor-elect Mary Fallin announced that she would retain General Deering in his position as adjutant general.
events.subject: self
events.quote: On December 10 , 2010 , Governor-elect Mary Fallin announced that she would retain General Deering in his position as adjutant general .

events.text: Myles Deering enlisted in the United States Army Reserve.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Myles Deering enlisted in the United States Army Reserve in October 1971

events.text: He transferred into the Texas Army National Guard and entered the Officer Candidate School program.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 1974 , he transferred into the Texas Army National Guard and entered the Officer Candidate School program

events.text: He received his commission as a second lieutenant in the 36th Infantry Brigade.
events.subject: self
events.quote: He received his commission as a second lieutenant in 1976 in the 36th Infantry Brigade

events.text: Lieutenant Deering transferred to the Oklahoma Army National Guards 45th Infantry Brigade.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Lieutenant Deering then transferred to the Oklahoma Army National Guards 45th Infantry Brigade in 1977

events.text: He was promoted to the rank of captain and assumed command of the Combat Support Company, 1st Battalion, 180th Infantry Regiment.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In March 1980 he was promoted to the rank of captain and assumed command of the Combat Support Company

events.text: Captain Deering was assigned to the 45th Infantry Brigades headquarters as an intelligence assistant.
events.subject: self
events.quote: By December 1981 , Captain Deering was assigned to

events.text: Deering became the commander of Company C, 1st Battalion, 180th Infantry Regiment based in Holdenville, Oklahoma.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 1983 , Deering became the commander of Company C , 1st Battalion , 180th Infantry Regiment

events.text: Captain Deering moved to the 700th Support Battalion in Oklahoma City as that Battalions executive officer.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In May 1986 , Captain Deering moved to the 700th Support Battalion in Oklahoma City

events.text: He was promoted to major.
events.subject: self
events.quote: He was promoted to major in February 1988

events.text: Major Deering returned to the 700th Support Battalion and assumed command of that unit with his promotion to lieutenant colonel.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Major Deering returned to the 700th Support Battalion in 1992 and assumed command of that unit

events.text: Colonel Deering became the executive officer for the 45th Infantry Brigade.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In June 1995 , Colonel Deering became the executive officer for the 45th Infantry Brigade

events.text: He was promoted to full colonel.
events.subject: self
events.quote: He was promoted to full colonel in July 1999

events.text: Colonel Deering began serving as Chief of the Joint Staff for the Joint Force Headquarters.
events.subject: self
events.quote: He would next serve as Chief of the Joint Staff for the Joint Force Headquarters in May 2003

events.text: Colonel Deering was reassigned to 45th Infantry Brigade and assumed command of the entire brigade.
events.subject: self
events.quote: By December 2004 , Colonel Deering was reassigned to 45th Infantry Brigade and assumed command of the entire brigade

events.text: He was promoted to brigadier general.
events.subject: self
events.quote: with promotion in February 2005

events.text: General Deering and the 45th Infantry Brigade were deployed to Iraq in support of Operation Iraqi Freedom.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In October 2007 , General Deering and the 45th Infantry Brigade were deployed to Iraq

events.text: He returned.
events.subject: self
events.quote: He returned in November 2008

events.text: He was promoted to major general with his assignment as director, manpower and personnel (J-1) at the National Guard Bureau in the Pentagon in Washington, D.C.
events.subject: self
events.quote: was promoted to major general on November 13 , 2008

events.text: He was appointed as the Adjutant General of the Oklahoma National Guard.
events.subject: self
events.object: Adjutant General of the Oklahoma National Guard
events.quote: He was appointed as the Adjutant General of the Oklahoma National Guard in February 2009

events.text: Governor of Oklahoma Brad Henry appointed General Deering to become the Adjutant General of Oklahoma.
events.subject: self
events.quote: On February 3 , 2009 , Governor of Oklahoma Brad Henry appointed General Deering to become the Adjutant General of Oklahoma .

events.text: Governor-elect Mary Fallin announced that she would retain General Deering under her administration in both of his positions.
events.subject: self
events.object: secretary of the military and adjutant general
events.quote: On December 10 , 2010 , Governor-elect Mary Fallin announced that she would retain General Deering

events.text: Deering received a Bachelor of Business Administration in Management from the University of Oklahoma.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Deering received a Bachelor of Business Administration in Management from the University of Oklahoma in 1980

events.text: Deering received a Master of Science degree in Natural and Applied Sciences from Oklahoma State University.
events.subject: self
events.quote: He also received a Master of Science degree in Natural and Applied Sciences from Oklahoma State University in 1996

events.text: Deering received a Master of Strategic Studies from the United States Army War College.
events.subject: self
events.quote: a Master of Strategic Studies from the United States Army War College in 2000
